Article Title: Gulzar Singh case: Complainant has no video of father’s death, cops tell Punjab and Haryana high court
Article Text:
The report also states that in another video, Gulzar can be seen asking questions regarding the incident and its details.





CHANDIGARH: Punjab govt has told the Punjab and Haryana high court that despite repeated efforts, the original video/device on which alleged suicide victim Gulzar Singh’s purported video was recorded has not been handed over to the police by the complainant or his family members.In its status report filed before the division bench of Chief Justice Ashwini Kumar and Justice Rohit Kapoor, the state govt said efforts were made to bring on record the original video/device, but the complainant and the family members of Gulzar Singh did not submit them.The report states that notices under Section 94 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) were issued to complainant Lakhwinder Singh, who is Gulzar’s son, on Sept 15, 17, 20 and 27 for the production of the device. The report stated that Lakhwinder, in his statement on Sept 27, stated that he did not have any video regarding the death of his father.The SIT, however, said multiple videos had been collected as part of the investigation through social-media monitoring. “The said videos have been obtained through social monitoring vide DDR No. 45 dated September 26, 2026,” the report states.It states that the videos are being analysed as “there are multiple videos with different versions”.According to the status report, in one of the videos, Gulzar Singh is heard naming Raj Sarpanch, Vicky, Sukha Conductor and Gona, who are accused in the present FIR. The report states that “his statement in the said video corroborates with the statement given by complainant Lakhwinder Singh”.The report also states that in another video, Gulzar can be seen asking questions regarding the incident and its details.The police said notices were also issued under Section 94 of the BNSS to media channels, calling upon them to provide the original video recordings along with requisite certificates under Section 63(4)(c) of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023, “for the purpose of establishing their authenticity”.The status report has been filed by Sangrur senior superintendent of police Dr Rajvot Grewal, a member of the special investigation team that is probing the suicide case, in compliance with the high court’s Sept 16 order.The report states that FIR No. 204 dated Sept 8 was registered at Dirba police station under Section 108 of the BNS and sections 3(1)(r) and 3(1)(s) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act against five persons — Baljit Singh alias Raj, Sukhdev Singh alias Sukha Conductor, Vicky Singh alias Vicky Member, Gona Singh and Baljinder Kaur.It states that Baljit, Vicky, Gona and Baljinder were arrested on Sept 8 and remanded in judicial custody. Sukhdev, however, “is absconding as on today”.Gulzar Singh, a 47-year-old agricultural laborer from Toor Banjara village in Punjab’s Sangrur district, died by suicide on Sept 7, after consuming poison following a public confrontation with Punjab finance minister Harpal Singh Cheema over the local drug menace on Sept 6.The SIT said a look-out circular was issued against Sukhdev, besides a message to all SHOs in Punjab, a public notice and letters to the Regional Transport Authority, Lead Bank, Sangrur, and Bureau of Immigration to trace him and gather information about his vehicle, financial transactions and travel history. Multiple raids were also conducted at his residence, relatives houses and other possible locations.A petition was filed before the Punjab and Haryana high court seeking transfer of the investigation to the CBI or another independent agency, alleging that Gulzar Singh had faced intimidation and that his video statement contained allegations against certain persons.
Article Summary: Gulzar Singh, a 47-year-old agricultural laborer from Toor Banjara village in Punjab’s Sangrur district, died by suicide on Sept 7, after consuming poison following a public confrontation with Punjab finance minister Harpal Singh Cheema.

Article Title: 'Protestors being assaulted even journalists not spared': 5 Left student organisations unite for Oct 10 Delhi stir
Article Text:
A ​protest by five Left student groups is scheduled for October 10 at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi​

Student bodies allege police action against protesters

Groups demand Gyanesh Kumar's resignation, SIR rollback





NEW DELHI: Five Left student organisations will join the October 10 protest at Jantar Mantar seeking the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and scrapping of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, the groups said in a joint statement on Tuesday.The student bodies also alleged that protesters and journalists have faced force during demonstrations against the Election Commission.The Students' Federation of India (SFI), All India Students' Federation (AISF), All India Students' Association (AISA), Progressive Students' Union (PSU) and All India Students' Bloc (AISB) said they would participate in the protest in large numbers.The five organisations said they were coming together to build a broader movement and urged democratic organisations and individuals who uphold constitutional values to participate in the October 10 demonstration."Thousands, irrespective of their socio-cultural backgrounds and political affiliations, have come together in defence of democratic values on which the imagination of modern India was built," the statement said.The organisations alleged that protests against the Election Commission of India and its functioning were being met with force by Delhi Police."Protestors are being manhandled, lathi-charged, dragged, assaulted and groped by Delhi Police.Even journalists are not being spared," they alleged.The protesters are seeking the resignation and prosecution of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, revocation of the SIR exercise and reforms in the Election Commission, the groups said.The statement was issued by SFI general secretary Srijan Bhattacharya, AISF general secretary Dinesh Srirangarajan, AISA general secretary Praseenjeet Kumar, PSU general secretary Balaram Sajeev and AISB convenor Amit Singh.(With PTI inputs)
Article Summary: Protest by five Left student groups is scheduled for October 10 at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi. Student bodies allege police action against protesters and journalists. Groups demand Gyanesh Kumar's resignation, SIR rollback and scrapping of electoral rolls.

Article Title: BMC scraps allotment of 5 school plots in Mumbai to private players
Article Text:
A high-level probe panel recommended the cancellation

Mumbai:

TOI





BMC has scrapped the allotment of five plots reserved for civic schools to private players under its public-private partnership (PPP) policy. The move came four months after city BJP chief Ameet Satam wrote a letter to BMC chief Ashwini Bhide and mayor Ritu Tawde demanding its cancellation. He had said the policy was framed “in haste” during the previous administrator’s rule, when BMC’s general body did not exist and without adequate consultation with elected representatives. Congress had backed the demand. BMC then formed a high-level probe committee under joint municipal commissioner Sanjog Kabre. The panel recommended that the allotments be cancelled. Bhide toldthat its report has been accepted. Seeking corrective action, Satam said BMC must appoint a committee to comprehensively review the policy, hold a detailed discussion in the civic House, and thereafter formulate and implement a balanced and inclusive policy.
Article Summary: BMC has scrapped the allotment of five plots reserved for civic schools to private players under its public-private partnership (PPP) policy. The move came four months after city BJP chief Ameet Satam wrote a letter to BMC chief Ashwini Bhide and mayor Ritu Tawde.

Article Title: ​Uddhav Thackeray’s name appears twice in Beed draft voter list
Article Text:
Uddhav Thackeray

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar





: The name Uddhav Thackeray figures at least twice in the draft voter list from Beed district for the Aurangabad Graduate Constituency election.Serial number 448 in the list mentions a voter named ‘Hrishikesh Uddhav Thackeray’. Further, two words in Marathi—ulthapalath kara (causing an upheaval) — are written behind the voter’s name, raising many eyebrows. Another entry, at serial number 150, lists a voter as ‘Omkar Uddhav Thackeray Mhaske’.Dilip Ghuge, who is contesting the Aurangabad Graduate Constituency election as the Shiv Sena (UBT) candidate, said he will meet with election authorities to seek a clarification. “It appears to be a major lapse and needs to be rectified at the earliest,” Ghuge said.Senior officials from the election branch at the office of Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar divisional commissioner could not be reached for comment.Around 2.8 lakh voters have already registered for the Aurangabad Division Graduates’ constituency poll. The last date for filing nominations for the election is Tuesday, while the deadline for the withdrawal of candidature is Oct 9. Polling will be held on Oct 23, with the counting of votes scheduled for Oct 27.
Article Summary: The name Uddhav Thackeray figures at least twice in the draft voter list from Beed district for the Aurangabad Graduate Constituency election. Two words in Marathi—ulthapalath kara (causing an upheaval) — are written behind the voter’s name, raising many eyebrows.

Article Title: ​Aurangabad Graduate Constituency poll: Rebellion within BJP as NCP is given the seat; cracks within MVA
Article Text:
Shiv Sena-BJP leaders during filing of nomination papers of NCP candidate Satish Chavan (left) on Monday

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

Cracks within MVA





: NCP on Monday nominated sitting MLC Satish Chavan for the Aurangabad Graduate Constituency. Chavan filed his nomination papers within hours of receiving the ticket, accompanied by senior BJP and Shiv Sena leaders.Although BJP leader Vinod Tawde visited Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar amid growing resentment among local party leaders over yielding the seat to an ally, BJP functionary M.K. Deshmukh announced his decision to contest the election independently. Deshmukh, a former education officer who quit Congress to join BJP last Oct with an eye on an MLC berth, confirmed he would file his nomination papers on Tuesday.“I will enter the poll fray to respect the sentiments of scores of party workers. BJP had been preparing for the Aurangabad Graduate Constituency for over a year. I will request the senior leadership to allow a friendly fight between me and the NCP candidate,” Deshmukh said.Addressing a rally in the city, Chavan said the graduate voters of Marathwada have given him the opportunity to represent them for three consecutive terms. “Looking back, there is satisfaction but also a profound void, as late DCM Ajit Pawar guided me at every important stage of my political and social journey.I am determined to move forward by following his teachings and vision for development.”Meanwhile, fissures have emerged within Maha Vikas Aghadi (MVA). Shiv Sena (UBT) has fielded Dilip Ghuge, who filed his nomination papers on Monday. NCP (SP) has decided to field its own candidate, Pratapsinha Patil, leading to a direct split in the opposition alliance’s votes.“We are contesting this election with full strength, and our role will be to deliver justice on issues facing educated graduates in Marathwada. We will firmly raise our voice regarding education, employment, and various other student grievances,” Ghuge said.NCP (SP) Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar district president Pandurang Tangde Patil insisted his party holds the rightful claim to the constituency. “This seat has been won by NCP for last three terms, so it should naturally remain with us. Senior MVA leaders will definitely discuss the implications of Shiv Sena (UBT) candidate filing a nomination,” Patil said.
Article Summary: NCP on Monday nominated sitting MLC Satish Chavan for the Aurangabad Graduate Constituency. Fissures have emerged within Maha Vikas Aghadi (MVA) Shiv Sena (UBT) has fielded Dilip Ghuge. NCP (SP) has decided to field its own candidate, Pratapsinha Patil.

Article Title: Latur: Four held for assaulting migrant workers
Article Text:
File photo

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar:





Four men have been arrested by Latur police after a group of migrant workers was allegedly assaulted with the blunt side of a sickle and kicked and punched on a deserted road in the Additional MIDC area of Harangul (Budruk) on Sept 27.The accused were identified by the complainant during the investigation and arrested by MIDC police on Sunday. One more accused is absconding and efforts are on to trace him.Police said complainant Rampati Gulab Singh, 25, a native of Agra in Uttar Pradesh and a cook at a sweets and snacks manufacturing unit in Additional MIDC, had gone with his colleagues to a grocery shop near their workplace around 7pm on Sept 27.While returning, the group was allegedly stopped by some men near a vehicle. The accused allegedly abused them without provocation and struck Singh on his left wrist with the blunt side of a sickle. When his colleague Vishnu Ranveer Singh intervened, he too was allegedly assaulted with kicks and blows and the blunt side of the sickle. Another colleague, Navinkumar Pritam Singh, was allegedly assaulted and threatened with death.Latur SP Amol Tambe said police acted promptly after the complaint and used information gathered during the investigation to identify the suspects.“The complainant was called to the police station and asked to identify the suspects. He identified the accused during the verification, following which four of them were arrested. The search for the absconding accused is underway,” he said.The arrested accused were identified as Ritesh Narayan Kalyankar, 23, originally from Kinala in Bhokar taluka of Nanded and currently residing in Harangul; Datta Girish Pawar, 22, of Hatte Nagar, Latur; Pradeep Anant Gaikwad, 20, of Additional MIDC; and Vishwajeet Balbhim Pandhare, a resident of Takalgaon in Renapur taluka and currently residing in Mahadev Nagar near Manjra Gate, Latur.Police are searching for the fifth accused, Pawan Balaji Jadhav, a native of Dornali in Mukhed taluka of Nanded and currently residing in Additional MIDC, Harangul.An FIR has been registered under Sections 118(1), 115(2), 352, 351(2), 189(2), 190 and 191(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, and Sections 4 and 25 of the Arms Act.PSI Suresh Pogulwar is investigating the case under the supervision of MIDC police inspector Samadhan Chavare.
Article Summary: Migrant workers were allegedly assaulted with the blunt side of a sickle and kicked and punched on a deserted road in Harangul. The accused were identified by the complainant during the investigation and arrested by MIDC police on Sunday. One more accused is absconding and efforts are on to trace him.

Article Title: Shinde claims Pune MLC teachers seat for his party’s candidate, discussed with Mahayuti politicians
Article Text:
Kolhapur:

Satej Slams BJP For Fielding Niece

Last Day For Filing Nominations Today





Deputy CM and Shiv Sena ’s chief leader Eknath Shinde said that Shiv Sena is going to contest the Pune division teachers’ constituency MLC seat and Mangesh Chivate will be the party’s official candidate. Shinde was speaking in New Delhi to reporters on Monday.The party has given the AB form to Chivate who toured five districts from the division multiple times and declared his candidature on various forums.Shinde’s remarks have come as a surprise since BJP declared candidates and got their nominations filed on Monday. BJP has nominated Kaustubh Gavde, chief executive officer of Kolhapur’s Swami Vivekanand Shikshan Sanstha, for the teachers’ constituency.“The discussion was held between CM Devendra Fadnavis , deputy CM Sunetra Pawar and me. It was discussed that Shiv Sena is going to contest Pune teachers constituency and Mangesh Chivate will be party’s official candidate,” said Shinde.BJP leader and minister Chandrakant Patil who leveraged his support behind Gavde had said that both of Pune division’s constituencies belong traditionally to BJP.Satej Patil , Congress MLC, has slammed BJP for fielding his niece Smita Jadhav for the Pune division graduates’ constituency.“Breaking others’ houses is BJP’s agenda. It will not work. Congress has given candidate for teachers constituency. NCP(SP) will nominate candidate for graduates constituency. I will stick to my party’s agenda and strongly support MVA’s candidates. For next 20 days, I will work in all five districts to help all MVA candidates win,” said Patil.Tuesday is the last day for filing of the nominations for the MLC polls. NCP(SP) did not announce its candidate by Monday night. It can be one of the two Mahayuti rebels, Pratap alias Bhaiya Mane and ex-bureaucrat Prabhakar Deshmukh’s daughter Harshada Deshmukh Jadhav.
Article Summary: Shiv Sena’s chief leader Eknath Shinde said that Shiv Sena is going to contest the Pune division teachers’ constituency MLC seat. Tuesday is the last day for filing of the nominations for the MLC polls. NCP(SP) did not announce its candidate by Monday night.

Article Title: Man in Mahindra Thar with duplicate plate molests woman, knocks down another in Kharghar
Article Text:
30-year-old man was apprehended for allegedly molesting a woman and injuring another in Navi Mumbai.





NAVI MUMBAI: A 30-year-old man wearing a mask and driving a red Thar SUV with a duplicate registration number plate was apprehended by the Crime Branch Unit-3 team within 10 hours on Thursday evening.He had allegedly molested a 26-year-old woman walking on the street in Kharghar, around 400metres from Pethpada metro station, on September 30 night and, an hour later, severely injured a 22-year-old woman by knocking her down in Belpada, Sector 3, Kharghar.Acting on a complaint by the woman allegedly molested by the Thar SUV driver, Kharghar police registered an FIR under BNS section 74 for the offence of assault or criminal force against a woman with the intent to outrage her modesty.While, as per the complaint by the injured woman Shrawani Dandekar, a resident of sector 3, Belpada, an FIR under relevant BNS sections and Motor Vehicle Act was registered against the Thar SUV driver for rash and negligent driving causing hurt.The detained aaccused identified as Ali alias Talib Ahsan Nakhvi, a resident of sector 50, Seawoods, Nerul was handed over to Kharghar police for further legal action.Previously, in January 2021, he was arrested by Nerul police in the FIR registered against him for alleged kidnapping, sexual harassment and molestation of a woman.Sanjay Joshi, senior inspector of Kharghar said, "The accused Nakhvi has been detained and subsequently it will be decided whether to arrest him or serve with a notice under Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) for cooperating in police investigating."Audumbar Patil, senior inspector of crime branch unit-3 said, "After an FIR for molestation was registered at Kharghar police station by the victim woman, a resident of sector 34, Kharghar. As per the orders of higher authority, our team started a parallel probe. From the CCTV camera surveillance near the crime scene, we obtained the red Thar SUV's registration number, which was of Vashi RTO passing.""When verified, the registration number was found to be that of a Maruti WagonR car. As the accused had used a duplicate registration number plate, we scrutinized as many as 62 Thar SUVs registered with various Regional Transport Offices (RTOs). Subsequently, we obtained the registration number of a red Thar SUV that was registered with Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar RTO," Patil added.SPI Patil further informed, "The SUV was registered in the name of Ali alias Talib Ahsan Nakhvi, a resident of Devaki Apartment in sector-50, Seawoods. From his mobile number registered with the RTO, his location was tracked.""He was apprehended from Bonkode village, Koparkhairane on Thursday late evening. Upon thorough interrogation, he confessed that he had inappropriately touched the woman pedestrian near Pethpada metro station while he drove his Thar SUV and sped away. He even confessed to have injured a woman pedestrian by hitting her his SUV while driving in Belpada area," he said.
Article Summary: A 30-year-old man wearing a mask and driving a red Thar SUV with a duplicate registration number plate was apprehended by the Crime Branch Unit-3 team on Thursday evening. He had allegedly molested a woman walking on the street in Kharghar, around 400metres from Pethpada metro station, on September 30 night. An hour later, he severely injured a woman by knocking her down in Belpada, Sector 3, KharGHar.

Article Title: Thane Shiv Sena (UBT) leader murder: 2 more arrested near Alibag while fleeing to Goa, total 3
Article Text:
Two additional suspects were arrested in connection with the murder of Shiv Sena division chief Pradeep Purnekar.





THANE: The Thane Crime Branch has arrested two more accused in connection with the murder of Shiv Sena (UBT) division chief Pradeep alias Balu Purnekar, taking the total number of arrests in the case to three.The arrested accused have been identified as Nikhil Yadav and Nitesh Pawar alias Bhavdya. The two were apprehended near Alibag while allegedly attempting to flee towards Goa, according to police sources.The Crime Branch reportedly traced the duo following information obtained during the questioning of suspects detained earlier in the case. Police teams had been searching for the accused after Purnekar was shot and attacked with a sharp-edged weapon at his office in Thane.According to investigators, Yadav allegedly opened fire on Purnekar, while Pawar allegedly attacked him with a sharp weapon. Police are now expected to question both accused to establish the sequence of events, the motive and the role of others involved in the alleged conspiracy.The two accused are expected to be produced before the Thane Sessions Court on Friday. Police will also attempt to recover the weapons allegedly used in the murder and investigate how the accused obtained them.Earlier, Prakash alias Papya Shinde was arrested in connection with the case. The police have also formed a Special Investigation Team (SIT) headed by DCP (Crime) Amarsingh Jadhav to conduct a detailed probe into the killing.The investigation is continuing, with police probing the alleged conspiracy, the role of other suspects and the possible involvement of the absconding accused.
Article Summary: The arrested accused have been identified as Nikhil Yadav and Nitesh Pawar alias Bhavdya. The two were apprehended near Alibag while allegedly attempting to flee towards Goa. Police are now expected to question both accused to establish the sequence of events, the motive and the role of others involved.

Article Title: Disha Salian case: Father, lawyer seek police protection, allege threats from Sena (UBT) leaders
Article Text:
Ojha questioned Aaditya Thackeray’s ‘Y-plus’ security, saying those who raised the issue and allegedly faced threats remained unprotected.

(With agency inputs)





THANE: Advocate Nilesh Ojha on Sunday said that Disha Salian’s father, Satish Salian, Sameer Wankhede, Ashutosh Pathak and he have sought police protection, alleging that they received threats from Shiv Sena (UBT) leaders.Ojha, who is representing Satish Salian in the case, said they have written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union home minister Amit Shah, the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), the Chief Justice of India and Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis, seeking protection."The CBI FIR was registered, and a letter was immediately written requesting police protection for four individuals: Satish Salian, our witness Sameer Wankhede, myself, and Ashutosh Pathak, " Ojha told news agency ANI.Ojha questioned the provision of ‘Y-plus’ security to Aaditya Thackeray , saying those who brought the matter to light and allegedly faced threats had been left without protection."The letter clearly states, citing records from your Home Ministry and the Narcotics Bureau, that it is evident that Aditya Thackeray is involved in the drug trade. Furthermore, an FIR has now been registered against him regarding gang rape, murder, and a cover-up.Several other high-profile individuals and police officers are also implicated as accused in this matter," he said."We have already provided all prima facie evidence; the CBI has obtained everything necessary during the investigation to secure a conviction. Yet, the accused currently enjoys 'Y-plus' security provided by your administration. Meanwhile, those who brought this matter to light and those facing direct threats from individuals like Sanjay Raut were left unprotected," the advocate added.He further said that providing security was mandatory under the Witness Protection Scheme and Supreme Court guidelines, and alleged that their request for protection had not been acted upon.He further added, "Providing security is mandatory under the Witness Protection Scheme and Supreme Court guidelines. Yet, they failed to do so. Consequently, we compiled all the material and handed it over to the CBI. We also urged them to investigate the role of Police Commissioner Deven Bharti and determine why police protection was not granted.""We have given a copy of this to the CBI, along with Prime Minister Modi ji, the Home Minister, the Chief Justice of India, and the Chief Minister," Ojha said.Disha Salian was found dead in Mumbai on June 8, 2020. Her death was initially registered as an Accidental Death Report (ADR).Salian died days before actor Sushant Singh Rajput , whose death also led to a high-profile investigation and widespread public controversy.Bombay High Court directed the CBI to register a formal First Information Report (FIR) and launch a fresh probe.As the probe progresses, Satish Salian, accompanied by his lawyer Nilesh Ojha, has submitted a pen drive containing material they described as evidence related to Disha Salian’s death.Meanwhile, Aaditya Thackeray has denied the allegations and responded to the defamation notice issued by Satish Salian.
Article Summary: Disha Salian’s father, Satish Salian, Sameer Wankhede, Ashutosh Pathak and he have sought police protection. They allege that they received threats from Shiv Sena (UBT) leaders. Ojha questioned the provision of ‘Y-plus’ security to Aaditya Thackeray. He said those who raised the issue and allegedly faced threats remained unprotected.

Article Title: One held for thrashing MSRTC bus driver in Chakan
Article Text:
Representative image

Pune:





Two men allegedly assaulted the driver of an MSRTC bus and smashed the windscreen of the bus in Chakan on the Chakan-Taleagon Road while the bus was moving towards Mumbai on Sunday. The police have arrested one of the two accused.Chakan North police registered a case against the duo under sections 132 (assault or criminal force to deter a public servant from discharging his duty), 121 (voluntarily causing hurt or grievous hurt to deter a public servant from his duty) and other relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). The 47-year-old bus driver lodged a complaint with the police.An officer from Chakan North police said that on Sunday afternoon, the complainant was driving the bus towards Mumbai. “While plying on the Chakan-Talegaon Road, a four-wheeler blocked his way. Two men from the vehicle got out and started abusing the complainant for honking. The driver of the four-wheeler, who was carrying an iron rod, assaulted the complainant. He also smashed the bus windscreen and window panes. ”The other accused abused the female bus conductor and threatened to beat her. “The accused are from a neighbouring village. We have caught one of the accused and he is remanded for three days. The search is on for the second individual,” the officer added.
Article Summary: Two men allegedly assaulted the driver of an MSRTC bus and smashed the windscreen of the bus in Chakan. The 47-year-old bus driver lodged a complaint with the police. The police have arrested one of the two accused.

Article Title: Woman (32) booked for extorting Rs14.30 lakh from medical practitioner in Pune
Article Text:
Pune:





A Dhanori-based medical practitioner (47), who runs a small hospital in the area, has lodged a complaint with Vishrantwadi police alleging that a woman (32) befriended him over the past year, threatened him and extorted Rs14.30 lakh from him.The woman, a Dhanori resident, allegedly extorted the money over the last two months, police said.According to police, the woman became close to the medical practitioner and the two were together frequently. The FIR states that she allegedly threatened to file false cases against him and defame him and his hospital. She allegedly called him and told him that if police arrested him and put him in prison, it would tarnish the hospital’s image and result in patients stopping visits.The medical practitioner paid her Rs14.30 lakh, but instead of severing ties with him, she continued to threaten him, police said.On Sept 13, she allegedly stole a register from the hospital containing details of patients and again demanded Rs10 lakh to return it.Following this, the medical practitioner approached the police and lodged a complaint against the woman. Police have registered a case against her and are investigating the allegations. The woman allegedly threatened the medical practitioner repeatedly and demanded money from him, taking advantage of their association over the past year, police said.
Article Summary: A Dhanori-based medical practitioner (47), who runs a small hospital in the area, has lodged a complaint with Vishrantwadi police. He alleges that a woman (32) befriended him over the past year, threatened him and extorted Rs14.30 lakh from him. Police have registered a case against her and are investigating the allegations.

Article Title: DMK’s Madurantakam candidate accuses CM Vijay of ‘purchasing MLAs’; TVK demands his disqualification
Article Text:
Charges Include Buying Votes & Violating Code

Chennai:





A day before the bypolls, DMK and TVK traded barbs accusing each other of violating the poll code.Speaking to reporters in Chennai, DMK’s Madurantakam candidate I Paranthamen raked up a complaint of horse-trading against TVK and demanded action against chief minister C Joseph Vijay. Meanwhile, former DMK minister V Senthilbalaji posted pictures of a sari and a lamp on his X handle and alleged that they were being distributed to voters in Dharapuram. While TVK denied the gift distribution charge, the party lodged a complaint against Paranthamen to Election Commission of India , alleging that DMK was ‘campaigning’ during the silent period and making baseless allegations against Vijay. In its complaint submitted to chief electoral officer Archana Patnaik, TVK also sought the disqualification of Paranthamen’s candidature, alleging that he had attempted to “illegally influence” voters in Madurantakam.Paranthamen said that two MDMK MLAs elected on the DMK symbol — T M Rajendran of Kadayanallur and R Senthil Selvan of Sirkazhi — had lodged separate complaints against Vijay to Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption (DVAC) on Oct 1. The complaint alleged that CM sought to lure the two and wanted them to resign from the assembly. But no action had been taken on the complaint so far, said Paranthamen. “If DVAC fails to register a case against Vijay, DMK will initiate legal action against him,” he said.He further alleged that TVK minister Aadhav Arjuna, MDMK general secretary Vaiko and his son Durai Vaiko were a part of the horse-trading attempt.Countering the charge, TVK legal wing representatives said they had petitioned CEO against Paranthamen for “attempting to influence voters through illegal means”. The complaint from Aadhav asked ECI to disqualify Paranthamen’s candidature and said he shouldn’t be allowed into Madurantakam constituency until the counting was over. “The CEO assured of appropriate action,” said a TVK functionary.TVK functionaries denied Senthilbalaji’s voter-bribing charges. The former DMK minister said voters in booth No. 30 of Manoorpalayam in Kundadam west union of Dharapuram assembly segment were given gifts. TVK dismissed the charge, stating that this “false campaign” was a last-minute attempt by DMK to damage the reputation of TVK.
Article Summary: DMK’s Madurantakam candidate I Paranthamen raked up a complaint of horse-trading against TVK and demanded action against chief minister C Joseph Vijay. Former DMK minister V Senthilbalaji posted pictures of a sari and a lamp on his X handle and alleged that they were being distributed to voters in Dharapuram. While TVK denied the gift distribution charge, the party lodged a complaint against Paranthaman to Election Commission of India.

Article Title: HC permits ECI to take back EVMs used for Perambur election
Article Text: HC permits ECI to take back EVMs used for Perambur election
Article Summary: HC permits ECI to take back EVMs used for Perambur election. ECI will use the EVMs in the upcoming by-elections in the state. Election will be held on November 26 and 27. The results will be announced on November 28.

Article Title: FIR against Udhayanidhi Stalin for involving child in poll campaign in Dharapuram
Article Text:
Authorities in Dharapuram have filed a case against Udhayanidhi Stalin for infringing on the Model Code of Conduct during a recent election rally





TIRUPUR: Dharapuram Police have registered a case against Tamil Nadu Assembly Opposition Leader Udhayanidhi Stalin for involving a child in an election campaign meeting at Dharapuram, where the Model Code of Conduct is in force for the bypoll.According to a press release issued by Tirupur district police, the incident took place on Saturday near the Periyar statue in Dharapuram town during an election campaign meeting addressed by Udhayanidhi.Police said the Election Commission had clearly instructed political parties and candidates not to involve children in any election-related activities.Police said Udhayanidhi made a child speak at the campaign meeting in a manner that was insulting to Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay and also used the child for election campaigning.Dharapuram Town Police registered a case against Udhayanidhi. Further investigation is under way, police said.
Article Summary: Tamil Nadu Assembly Opposition Leader Udhayanidhi Stalin involved a child in an election campaign meeting at Dharapuram. The Model Code of Conduct is in force for the bypoll. Police said the Election Commission had clearly instructed political parties and candidates not to involve children in election-related activities.

Article Title: 864 bottles of liquor seized from house near Erode; man arrested
Article Text: ERODE: Police seized 864 bottles of Indian made foreign liquor (IMFL) from a house near Mylambadi in Erode district in the early hours of Thursday and arrested a man.Acting on a tip-off that bottles of liquor had been illegally stored for unauthorised sale, the Bhavani police conducted a raid at the house of K Govindaraj, 28, of Ammapalayam. They found 864 bottles of IMFL stocked in the house for illegal sale.Police registered a case and arrested Govindaraj. He was remanded in judicial custody.They launched a search for Sekar alias Ammasai, 34, and Sridhar, 38, who have links with the illegal liquor operation.
Article Summary: Police seized 864 bottles of Indian made foreign liquor (IMFL) from a house near Mylambadi in Erode district. Acting on a tip-off that bottles of liquor had been illegally stored for unauthorised sale, the Bhavani police conducted a raid.

Article Title: Expelled BJP man seeks anticipatory bail in sexual harassment case
Article Text:
Madurai:





Expelled BJP state general secretary Karuppu M Muruganantham moved Madras high court seeking anticipatory bail in the sexual harassment case filed against him by a woman functionary.The court was hearing the anticipatory bail petition filed by Muruganantham, who apprehends arrest in a case registered against him by the Srirangam all-women police in Trichy district.According to the prosecution, a woman BJP functionary submitted a complaint accusing Muruganantham of sexual exploitation, harassment, repeated threats, and circulating her private images and videos on social media. Based on her complaint, police had registered a case. Following the complaint, Muruganantham was removed from his post in the party.In his petition, Muruganantham stated that he is innocent and has not committed any offence as alleged in the FIR. The woman had lodged a false complaint to damage his reputation. Hence, he sought anticipatory bail.Justice K Murali Shankar posted the case for hearing on October 9.
Article Summary: Karuppu M Muruganantham moved Madras high court seeking anticipatory bail in the sexual harassment case filed against him by a woman functionary. He apprehends arrest in a case registered by the Srirangam all-women police in Trichy district. The woman had lodged a false complaint to damage his reputation.

Article Title: Couple held in FQL scam detained under Goondas Act
Article Text:
Couple held in FQL scam detained under Goondas Act





Madurai: A couple accused in the FQL online investment scam in Melur were detained under the Goondas Act on Sunday.Madurai district collector Nishant Krishna issued orders to detain Ranjith , 29, and Priyadharshini, 23, under the Act.Thousands of people lost money after investing through FQL platform on the promise that their investments would double.Economic offences wing (EOW) superintendent of police (south zone) K Saravana Kumar recommended that the couple be detained under the Goondas Act. Subsequently, Madurai collector issued detention orders. The orders were served on the couple, who were already in prison.
Article Summary: Ranjith, 29, and Priyadharshini, 23, were detained under the Goondas Act. Thousands of people lost money after investing through FQL platform on the promise that their investments would double. The orders were served on the couple, who were already in prison.

Article Title: Traffic affected on Salem-Madurai National Highway after trailer truck crashes near Rasipuram
Article Text: NAMAKKAL: Traffic was affected for more than an hour on the Salem-Madurai National Highway near Rasipuram in Namakkal district on Thursday afternoon after a trailer truck crashed while descending the Andagalur Gate flyover.No casualties or injuries were reported.The truck was carrying about 60 tonnes of steel angles from Maharashtra to Karur. An officer at the Rasipuram police station said the driver lost control of the vehicle while descending the flyover around 1.30pm. The truck hit a streetlight pole on the roadside. “The vehicle partially blocked the road, causing congestion and delays for motorists and commuters,” he said.Vehicles piled up for two kilometres on the NH. The Rasipuram police reached the spot after receiving information, regulated traffic and moved the truck to the roadside.Police registered a case and were investigating the circumstances leading to the crash.
Article Summary: Trailer truck crashes on Salem-Madurai National Highway near Rasipuram. Truck was carrying 60 tonnes of steel angles from Maharashtra to Karur. Driver lost control of the vehicle while descending the flyover. No casualties or injuries were reported.

Article Title: Four booked for assaulting KSU worker at college in North Paravur
Article Text:
Kochi

:





North Paravur Police registered a case against four persons for allegedly assaulting a KSU worker following the organisation’s victory in a college union election at Kesari Govt Arts and Science College, North Paravur on Monday.The accused, Akhil Suresh, Yasin, Adithyan and Kasinadh, allegedly attacked KSU worker Sreesanth P, 21, and another student Sibin Benny around 4pm on the college campus.As per the FIR, the accused were SFI or DYFI workers. Sreesanth allegedly sustained injuries after one of the accused struck him on the head with a broken wooden plank. He was also allegedly hit on the right shoulder, neck and knee. The accused allegedly assaulted Sibin and tore Sreesanth’s shirt during the incident.Police registered a case under Sections 126(2) (wrongful restraint), 115(2) (voluntarily causing hurt), 118(1) (voluntarily causing hurt using dangerous weapons), 110 (attempt to commit culpable homicide) and 3(5) (common intention) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.
Article Summary: KSU worker Sreesanth P, 21, and another student Sibin Benny were allegedly attacked on the college campus. The accused were SFI or DYFI workers. Police registered a case under Sections 126(2) (wrongful restraint), 115(2), 118(1) (voluntarily causing hurt using dangerous weapons), 110 (attempt to commit culpable homicide)

Article Title: Police arrest two men for alleged gang rape at Edappally lodge
Article Text:
Kochi

Man held for sexually abusing co-worker:





Two men were arrested in connection with the alleged gang rape and repeated sexual assault of a woman at a private lodge in Edappally on Friday.The arrested men were Sreeraj, 30, of Karthikappally, Alappuzha, and Jith Martin, 27, of Thevakkal, Ernakulam.Police said the woman was allegedly lured with the promise of employment at spas. The accused allegedly gave her beer and narcotic substances before sexually assaulting her.According to the police, a woman was also part of the gang. Police said that, as per the survivor’s statement, she became unconscious and realised the next morning that she had been sexually assaulted.City police commissioner Kaliraj Mahesh Kumar said the woman met the gang after responding to an advertisement on an online platform.The woman attended an interview and was told that she was selected. They called her again in the evening, and invited her to a party, said the officer, adding that the details need to be verified.The commissioner said the woman was in shock and initially hesitant to file a complaint. A medical examination was held and there were injuries to the body due to sexual abuse.He added that surprise inspections were held at spas where illegal activities have been reported.One of the accused was running at least three spas, and searches were held in these establishments, police said. Police said more arrests are likely in the case and a detailed investigation is on into the racket.The arrested men were remanded to judicial custody. They were arrested by a team led by Kalamassery inspector Abhilash A L, along with sub-inspectors Ram Lal and Binu V S, SCPO Libin Kumar, and officers Sijil Suresh and Aneesh.An employee of an online media channel was arrested for allegedly sexually harassing and verbally abusing a female colleague. The accused is Ranji Varghese, of Kaloor, Ernakulam.According to the police, the complainant and her colleagues had attended Kerala Travel Mart, inaugurated by chief minister, at Grand Hyatt hotel in Bolgatty on Sept 24. While returning from the event, Ranji offered to drop the woman at her hostel. During the journey, he allegedly touched her with sexual intent and made sexually suggestive remarks, causing her mental distress.The woman subsequently filed a complaint at the Mulavukad police station, following which a case was registered. Suspecting that the police had registered a case against him, the accused went into hiding. Acting on information gathered with the assistance of the cyber cell, police arrested him from a bar in Ernakulam.Police also recovered the vehicle allegedly used in the incident. The accused was produced before a court and remanded in judicial custody.The arrest was carried out by the investigation team of the ACP’s office and Mulavukad police under the direction of Central ACP C B Tom. Mulavukad station house officer Naseem, sub-inspector Shaji, assistant sub-inspector Sunil Jalil and senior civil police officers Prashanth Babu, Ajilesh and Vibin were part of the investigation team.
Article Summary: Two men were arrested in connection with the alleged gang rape and repeated sexual assault of a woman at a private lodge in Edappally on Friday. The arrested men were Sreeraj, 30, of Karthikappally, Alappuzha, and Jith Martin, 27, of Thevakkal, Ernakulam.

Article Title: Accused in foreign job fraud case moves Kerala HC for pre-arrest bail
Article Text:
Kochi

:





Parvathy Maya Shaji, an accused who was arrested by the police for alleged job fraud and later enlarged on bail, has approached the high court seeking pre-arrest bail in similar cases registered after her release.A bench of Justice C Jayachandran sought instructions from the govt on the petition and adjourned the matter to Oct 13. Parvathy, who runs Amster Overseas Pvt Ltd, an agency engaged in recruiting and supplying human resources abroad, was arrested by the police at Thiruvananthapuram airport on Sept 24 when she arrived from abroad. The arrest was made on complaints by three youths alleging that they had been cheated after being promised jobs in Armenia and Poland. Later, on Sept 28, the magistrate court granted bail to her.However, she approached the HC seeking anticipatory bail in other cases registered against her after she was released on bail. According to her, the cases were registered at the instance of rival agencies in the employment market. She further claimed that she had already settled more than 100 claims and was ready to settle all genuine claims supported by records of payments made to the firm. She also sought a directive to the police to issue prior notice to her before requiring her to appear in the cases.
Article Summary: Parvathy Maya Shaji was arrested by the police at Thiruvananthapuram airport on Sept 24 when she arrived from abroad. The arrest was made on complaints by three youths alleging that they had been cheated after being promised jobs in Armenia and Poland. Later, on Sept 28, the magistrate court granted bail to her. She approached the HC seeking anticipatory bail in other cases registered against her.
